Binning of the assembled contigs into genomes with MetaBAT 2. Commands for this step were run in `metabat/`.

## **Step 3: Binning with metabat**

Flye finished running, so i moved on to binning the contigs with MetaBAT 2

Moved into the `metabat` folder

```{bash}
cd ~/bbd-metagenome/metabat
```

Extract the depth (coverage) of each contig from Flye's `assembly_info.txt` into `depth_bbd.txt`. MetaBAT uses depth to group contigs that likley come from the same organism.

```{bash}
cat ../flye/bbd/assembly_info.txt  | grep -v '#' | awk '{OFS="\t";print $1,$3}' > depths_bbd.txt
```

Reorder the contigs based n the depth file, saved as `assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta`

```{bash}
cat depths_bbd.txt | awk '{print $1}' | xargs samtools faidx ../flye/bbd/assembly.fasta > assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta
```

Ran MetaBAT 2 with the depth file.

```{bash}
metabat2 -i assembly_bbd_ordered.fasta -a depths_bbd.txt --cvExt -o bins_bbd/metabat --seed 5
```

Metabat created 69 bins, saved in `bins_bbd/`
